title: Hadjar ruled out of Dutch GP as Lawson steps into Red Bull
excerpt: Isack Hadjar will miss the Dutch Grand Prix after a wrist injury in training. Liam Lawson moves into the Red Bull seat, while Yuki Tsunoda returns at Racing Bulls for the Zandvoort sprint weekend.
content: Red Bull confirmed a late driver change before Zandvoort, with Liam Lawson replacing the injured Isack Hadjar and Yuki Tsunoda filling Lawson's Racing Bulls seat.
For forecasting, the compressed sprint format increases the value of quick adaptation, setup feedback and clean qualifying execution.

title: Dutch Grand Prix begins Friday with Zandvoort sprint weekend
excerpt: Formula 1 returns from the summer break on 21–23 August. Friday brings practice and sprint qualifying, Saturday the sprint and main qualifying, and Sunday the 72-lap Dutch Grand Prix.
content: The Dutch Grand Prix runs from 21 to 23 August at Zandvoort and uses the sprint format in 2026.
The narrow circuit puts extra emphasis on qualifying position, race starts and strategy because overtaking opportunities are limited.

title: Cincinnati Open reaches quarterfinal stage
excerpt: The ATP and WTA 1000 event moves into quarterfinal sessions on 20 August as the hard-court swing approaches its final weekend before the US Open build-up intensifies.
content: Cincinnati Open quarterfinal sessions are scheduled for Thursday 20 August, with additional quarterfinal play on Friday before the weekend semifinals and finals.
Recovery time and accumulated match load become increasingly important forecasting inputs this deep into a two-week hard-court event.

title: Nakashima saves three match points in Medvedev upset
excerpt: Brandon Nakashima beat Daniil Medvedev 6-7(3), 7-6(4), 6-1 after saving three match points, extending a strong summer hard-court run in Cincinnati.
content: Nakashima recovered from a set down and saved three match points before pulling away in the deciding set against Medvedev.
The result reinforces his strong North American hard-court form and raises his momentum signal ahead of the later Cincinnati rounds.

title: Arsenal open Premier League title defence against Coventry on Friday
excerpt: The 2026/27 Premier League season starts on 21 August with champions Arsenal hosting promoted Coventry City at the Emirates Stadium at 20:00 UK time.
content: Arsenal host Coventry City in the opening match of the new Premier League season on Friday 21 August.
Coventry return to the top flight after 25 years, while Arsenal begin the defence of the title they won last season.

title: Arsenal carry 3-0 Community Shield win into league opener
excerpt: Arsenal beat Manchester City 3-0 in the Community Shield, giving the champions a strong competitive reference point before Friday's Premier League opener.
content: Arsenal defeated Manchester City 3-0 in the Community Shield with goals from Riccardo Calafiori, Kai Havertz and Martin Odegaard.
The result provides a useful recent form signal, although opening-weekend uncertainty remains higher than later in the season.

title: Verstappen targets home farewell as Dutch GP leaves calendar
excerpt: Max Verstappen heads to Zandvoort seeking a first win of the season at his home race, which is set to leave the Formula 1 calendar after 2026.
content: Verstappen has finished on the podium in every Dutch Grand Prix since Zandvoort returned to the championship in 2021.
The 2026 weekend adds a sprint format and late driver changes, increasing the number of variables before Sunday’s race.

title: LIV Golf ends 2026 season early and cancels Michigan event
excerpt: LIV Golf cancelled its planned Michigan team championship and will conclude the season in Indianapolis while preparing for a transition involving new investors.
content: LIV Golf will finish its 2026 campaign earlier than planned after cancelling the Michigan team championship scheduled for 27–30 August.
The calendar change shifts the final competitive attention to the Indianapolis event and removes a late-August golf traffic window.
